LanguageData.SK_Rec1: Every colonist carries a small kit for his role
LanguageData.SK_Rec2: Missing items are picked up from storage nearby
LanguageData.SK_Rec3: Doctors give the right drug by how serious it is
LanguageData.SK_Rec4: Caravans pack the kits of their members
LanguageData.SK_KitsOn_Desc: Every colonist carries the items of his role's kit in his inventory (medicine for doctors, food for hunters, components for builders …).
LanguageData.SK_Refill_Desc: When something from the kit is missing, the colonist picks it up from a stockpile or shelf nearby (Basic work, short walks only).
LanguageData.SK_NoGame: Load a game to see your colonists here.
LanguageData.SK_KitsHelp: The table was filled in automatically – change it as you like. A colonist's role comes from Steward – Roles, otherwise from his best skills. "Medicine" means the best medicine his skill should use.
LanguageData.SK_CaravanKits_Desc: When a caravan is formed, the kit items its members don't carry yet are added to the packing list (if there are some in storage).
LanguageData.SK_CaravanHelp: You can still change the packing list yourself – the kits are only added at the start.
LanguageData.SK_Weight: Kit may use up to {0} % of carrying capacity
LanguageData.SK_Weight_Desc: A colonist never takes more kit than this share of what he can carry, so he is never slowed down.
LanguageData.SK_Distance: Walk at most {0} cells for a refill
LanguageData.SK_Distance_Desc: Kit items farther away are left for later.
LanguageData.SK_CheckHours: Check a full kit again every {0} h
LanguageData.SK_CheckHours_Desc: Lower = kits refilled sooner, a little more work for the game.
LanguageData.SK_DropExtras_Desc: A colonist with more kit items than his kit wants (e.g. after a role change) drops the rest at home; they get hauled to storage.
LanguageData.SK_Spare_Desc: How many items above the kit are still fine (no back-and-forth).
LanguageData.SK_ColonistsHelp: Each colonist carries the kit of his role automatically. Here you can give a colonist another kit or none.
LanguageData.SK_EveryonePack_Desc: The "Everyone" lines (a meal and a medicine by default) are carried by every colonist on top of his role kit.
LanguageData.SK_CombatDrugKit_Desc: Used by the pharmacy's combat drug rule: once per fight, never with a chance of addiction.
LanguageData.SK_RolesOn: Steward – Roles is on: the kits follow the roles you gave your colonists.
LanguageData.SK_RolesOff: Steward – Roles is off: a colonist's kit follows his best skill (doctor, hunter, builder, cook). Soldier kits need Steward – Roles or a choice in the Colonists tab.
LanguageData.SK_OldPharmacy: The old Auto Pharmacy mod is still on – its own pharmacy works and the one inside Steward – Kit stays off. Switch Auto Pharmacy off in the mod list (your settings are taken over).
LanguageData.SK_SelfDose_Desc: A colonist who needs a drug takes it himself under Basic work – he does not have to wait for a doctor or have the Doctor work on.
LanguageData.SK_CombatHelp: A drafted fighter with enemies close takes one combat drug from his inventory – once per fight, never with a chance of addiction. Switch it off per colonist with his gizmo.
LanguageData.SK_FamilyHelp: Family plan: a button on every adult colonist – no children (contraception given regularly) or children wanted (fertility drug).
LanguageData.SK_FamilyNone: Family plan appears when a mod adds contraceptive or fertility drugs.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOn: The mod sets itself up and works right away. Ideal for new players and anyone who does not want to tweak anything.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOffSame: Custom settings. Still the same as recommended.
LanguageData.MUI_ConfirmOn: Turn recommended settings on? Your changes ({0}) will be replaced with the recommended values.
LanguageData.MUI_Locked: Detailed settings are locked. Want to change them? Turn off the switch above – your values start from the recommended ones.
LanguageData.MUI_ChangedTip: Differs from the recommended setting ({0}). Click to restore the recommended value.
